# Contract: teach-back

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: learning. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
The learner explains, gaps are probed one question at a time, and a cheat sheet with spaced review questions is produced.

## Use it for
- "quiz me on this"
- "test my understanding"

## Not for
- teach me from zero (learn-a-domain or from-scratch)

## Accepted inputs
A topic and optional source material.

## Deliverables
Gap list, cheatsheet-<topic>.md with review questions.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- none

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local only: reads and writes files on this machine.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.

## Workflow
1. Set up
2. They explain, you listen
3. Probe the gaps
4. Cheat sheet
5. Spaced review

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Depth needed

## Quality checks
- Corrections grounded in the source

## Common failures
- Marking right answers wrong

## Limitations
- Guidance only; tested with scenarios
